Container.Name: caddy-reverse-proxy
Container.Overview: Caddy reverse proxy with automatic HTTPS via Cloudflare DNS-01 challenge. Routes subdomains to Docker containers with auto-managed SSL certificates.
Container.Description: Caddy reverse proxy built with the Cloudflare DNS plugin for automatic SSL certificate provisioning via DNS-01 challenges. Ideal for servers behind Tailscale or NAT where HTTP-01 challenges cannot reach the server. Edit the Caddyfile to map subdomains to your containers. Certificates are automatically obtained, renewed, and managed by Caddy.

Config.Name: Cloudflare API Token
Config.Description: Cloudflare API token with Zone:DNS:Edit permission for your domain
